objects.description: [WhisperGate](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0689) overwrites the MBR with a bootloader component that performs destructive wiping operations on hard drives and displays a fake ransom note when the host boots.(Citation: Crowdstrike WhisperGate January 2022)(Citation: Cybereason WhisperGate February 2022)(Citation: Microsoft WhisperGate January 2022)(Citation: Cisco Ukraine Wipers January 2022)(Citation: Medium S2W WhisperGate January 2022)
objects.description_fa: [WhisperGate](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0689) MBR را با یک مؤلفه بوت‌لودر بازنویسی می‌کند که عملیات پاک‌سازی مخرب را روی دیسک‌های سخت انجام می‌دهد و هنگام میزبانی، یادداشت باج‌گیری جعلی را نمایش می‌دهد. چکمه.(Citation: Crowdstrike WhisperGate January 2022)(Citation: Cybereason WhisperGate February 2022)(Citation: Microsoft WhisperGate January 2022)(Citation: Cisco Ukraine Wipers January 2022)(Citation: Medium S2W WhisperGate January 2022)
